        if req_pkt[8] != res_pkt[8]:
            raise MctpVdmCmd.InvalidPacket(
                f"VDM command version mismatch {req_pkt[8]}:{res_pkt[8]}"
            )
        if res_pkt[9] != 0:
            raise MctpVdmCmd.CcError(res_pkt)

    def execute(self, **arg) -> list[int]:
        cmd, ver, message = self._req(**arg)
        req_pkt = self._create_req(cmd, ver, message)
        self._client.write(req_pkt)
        res_pkt = self._client.read()
        self._verify_res(req_pkt, res_pkt)
        return res_pkt[10:]


class MctpSpdmCmd(MctpCmd):
    class SpdmMessageOutOfSyncError(MctpException):
        ...

    class SpdmResponderErrorCode(MctpException):
        ...

    class SpdmVerificationFailed(MctpException):
        ...

    @classmethod
    def _create_req(cls, ver: int, request_cmd: int, msg: list[int]) -> list[int]:
        packet = []
        packet.append(MCTP_MESSAGE_TYPE.SPDM)  # msg type, SPDM message type
        packet.append(ver)  # SPDM Version V1.0 = 0x10
        packet.append(request_cmd)  # SPDM request command
        packet.extend(msg)  # message
        return packet

    @classmethod
    def _verify_res(cls, req_pkt: list[int], res_pkt: list[int]) -> None:
        # common usage of req/res code pairs
        SPDM_REQ_RES_CODE_DEF = {
            0x84: 0x04,  # GET_VERSION : VERSION
            0xE1: 0x61,  # GET_CAPABILITIES : CAPABILITIES
            0xE3: 0x63,  # NEGOTIATE_ALGORITHMS : ALGORITHMS
            0x81: 0x01,  # GET_DIGESTS : DIGESTS
            0x82: 0x02,  # GET_CERTIFICATE : CERTIFICATE
            0xE0: 0x60,  # GET_MEASUREMENTS : MEASUREMENTS
        }
        if req_pkt[0] != res_pkt[0]:
            raise MctpSpdmCmd.InvalidPacket(
                f"Message type mismatch {req_pkt[0]}:{res_pkt[0]}"
            )
        if res_pkt[0] != MCTP_MESSAGE_TYPE.SPDM:
            raise MctpSpdmCmd.InvalidPacket("Response MCTP Message Type is not SPDM")

        SPDM_CODE_ERROR = 0x7F
        # check the response pair match, is not match, will raise error
        req_spdm_code = req_pkt[2]
        res_spdm_code = res_pkt[2]
        if (
            req_spdm_code in SPDM_REQ_RES_CODE_DEF
            and res_spdm_code != SPDM_CODE_ERROR
            and SPDM_REQ_RES_CODE_DEF[req_spdm_code] != res_spdm_code
        ):
            raise cls.SpdmMessageOutOfSyncError(
                f"response code is {ByteFormatter.bytes_to_str(res_pkt[2:3],100)} expecting {ByteFormatter.bytes_to_str([SPDM_REQ_RES_CODE_DEF.get(req_pkt[2])],100)}, message: {ByteFormatter.bytes_to_str(res_pkt,100)}"
            )

        # receive the error response
        if res_spdm_code == SPDM_CODE_ERROR:
            raise cls.SpdmResponderErrorCode(
                f"response code is {ByteFormatter.bytes_to_str([res_spdm_code],100)}, spdm context enter error status, message: {ByteFormatter.bytes_to_str(res_pkt,100)}"
            )
        return None

    def execute(self, need_req_pkt: bool = False, **arg) -> list[int]:
        cmd, ver, message = self._req(**arg)
        req_pkt = self._create_req(cmd, ver, message)
        self._client.write(req_pkt)
        res_pkt = self._client.read()
        self._verify_res(req_pkt, res_pkt)
        if need_req_pkt is True:
            return (req_pkt[1:], res_pkt[1:])
        else:
            # drop the byte of message type (0x05)
            return res_pkt[1:]


class MctpNsmCmd(MctpCmd):
    @classmethod
    def _create_req(cls, type: int, cmd: int, msg: list[int]) -> list[int]:
        packet = []
        packet.append(MCTP_MESSAGE_TYPE.NSM)  # msg type, vendor defined: PCI
        packet.extend([0x10, 0xDE])  # NV PCI Vendor ID
        packet.append(0x81)  # rq + d + rsvd + instance ID
        packet.append(0x89)  # OCP + OCP Type + OCP Version
        packet.append(type & 0xFF)  # Nvidia Message Type
        packet.append(cmd & 0xFF)  # NSM command code
        packet.append(len(msg))  # data size
        packet.extend(msg)  # data
        return packet

    @classmethod
    def _verify_res(cls, req_pkt: list[int], res_pkt: list[int]) -> None:
        size = int.from_bytes(res_pkt[10:12], byteorder="little")
        if req_pkt[0] != res_pkt[0]:
            raise MctpNsmCmd.InvalidPacket(
                f"Message type mismatch 0x{req_pkt[0]:02X}:0x{res_pkt[0]:02X}"
            )
        if req_pkt[1:3] != list(res_pkt[1:3]):
            raise MctpNsmCmd.InvalidPacket(
                f"PCI vendor ID mismatch {req_pkt[1:3]}:{list(res_pkt[1:3])}"
            )
        if req_pkt[3] & 0x1F != res_pkt[3] & 0x1F:
            raise MctpNsmCmd.InvalidPacket(
                f"Instance ID mismatch {req_pkt[3] & 0x1F}:{res_pkt[3] & 0x1F}"
            )
        if req_pkt[4] != res_pkt[4]:
            raise MctpNsmCmd.InvalidPacket(
                f"OCP, OCP type, OCP version mismatch {req_pkt[4]}:{res_pkt[4]}"
            )
        if req_pkt[5] != res_pkt[5]:
            raise MctpNsmCmd.InvalidPacket(
                f"Nvidia message type mismatch {req_pkt[5]}:{res_pkt[5]}"
            )
        if req_pkt[6] != res_pkt[6]:
            raise MctpNsmCmd.InvalidPacket(
                f"NSM command code mismatch {req_pkt[6]}:{res_pkt[6]}"
            )
        if res_pkt[7] != 0:
            raise MctpNsmCmd.CcReasonError(res_pkt)
        # Skip the size check for get rot state information (no data size for get rot state information)
        # Also skip for aggregate messages and debug token commands
        if (
            (
                req_pkt[5] == AGGREGATE.FIRMWARE_MSG
                and req_pkt[6] == AGGREGATE.GET_ROT_STATE_CMD
            )
            or (
                req_pkt[5] == AGGREGATE.TELEMETRY_MSG
                and req_pkt[6] == AGGREGATE.TELEMETRY_TEMPERATURE_CMD
                and req_pkt[8] == AGGREGATE.AGGREGATE_TELEMETRY_REQUEST
            )
            or (
                req_pkt[5] == AGGREGATE.TELEMETRY_MSG
                and req_pkt[6] == AGGREGATE.TELEMETRY_POWERDRAW_CMD
                and req_pkt[8] == AGGREGATE.AGGREGATE_TELEMETRY_REQUEST
            )
            or (
                req_pkt[5] == AGGREGATE.TELEMETRY_MSG
                and req_pkt[6] == AGGREGATE.TELEMETRY_VOLTAGE_CMD
                and req_pkt[8] == AGGREGATE.AGGREGATE_TELEMETRY_REQUEST
            )
            or (
                req_pkt[5] == AGGREGATE.DIAG_MSG
                and req_pkt[6] == AGGREGATE.DEVICE_RESET_STAT
            )
            or (
                req_pkt[5] == 0x04 and req_pkt[6] in (0x01, 0x02, 0x03)
            )  # Debug Token: Install(0x01), Erase(0x02), Query(0x03)
            or (req_pkt[5] == 0x00 and req_pkt[6] == 0x11)  # Get Device Capabilities V2
        ):
            return
        else:
            if size != len(res_pkt[12:]):
                raise MctpNsmCmd.InvalidPacket(
                    f"Data size mismatch {size}:{len(res_pkt[12:])}"
                )

    def execute(self, **arg) -> list[int]:
        type, cmd, message = self._req(**arg)
        req_pkt = self._create_req(type, cmd, message)
        self._client.write(req_pkt)
        res_pkt = self._client.read()
        self._verify_res(req_pkt, res_pkt)
        # get rot state information don't have reserved (2 bytes) & data size (2 bytes)
        if (
            (
                req_pkt[5] == AGGREGATE.FIRMWARE_MSG
                and req_pkt[6] == AGGREGATE.GET_ROT_STATE_CMD
            )
            or (
                req_pkt[5] == AGGREGATE.TELEMETRY_MSG
                and req_pkt[6] == AGGREGATE.TELEMETRY_TEMPERATURE_CMD
                and req_pkt[8] == AGGREGATE.AGGREGATE_TELEMETRY_REQUEST
            )
            or (
                req_pkt[5] == AGGREGATE.TELEMETRY_MSG
                and req_pkt[6] == AGGREGATE.TELEMETRY_POWERDRAW_CMD
                and req_pkt[8] == AGGREGATE.AGGREGATE_TELEMETRY_REQUEST
            )
            or (
                req_pkt[5] == AGGREGATE.TELEMETRY_MSG
                and req_pkt[6] == AGGREGATE.TELEMETRY_VOLTAGE_CMD
                and req_pkt[8] == AGGREGATE.AGGREGATE_TELEMETRY_REQUEST
            )
            or (
                req_pkt[5] == AGGREGATE.DIAG_MSG
                and req_pkt[6] == AGGREGATE.DEVICE_RESET_STAT
            )
            or (req_pkt[5] == 0x00 and req_pkt[6] == 0x11)  # Get Device Capabilities V2
        ):
            return res_pkt[8:]
        else:
            return res_pkt[12:]


class MctpNsmCmdV2(MctpCmd):
    @classmethod
    def _create_req(cls, type: int, cmd: int, msg: list[int]) -> list[int]:
        packet = []
        packet.append(MCTP_MESSAGE_TYPE.NSM)  # msg type, vendor defined – PCI
        packet.extend([0x10, 0xDE])  # NV PCI Vendor ID
        packet.append(0x81)  # rq + d + rsvd + instance ID
        packet.append(0x8A)  # OCP + OCP Type + OCP Version
        packet.append(type & 0xFF)  # Nvidia Message Type
        packet.append(cmd & 0xFF)  # NSM command code
        packet.append(0x00)  # reserved
        # 2 bytes for data size (little-endian)
        data_size = len(msg)
        packet.extend(
            [data_size & 0xFF, (data_size >> 8) & 0xFF]
        )  # data size as 2 bytes
        packet.extend([0x00, 0x00])  # 2 bytes padding after data size
        packet.extend(msg)  # data
        return packet

    @classmethod
    def _verify_res(cls, req_pkt: list[int], res_pkt: list[int]) -> None:
        size = int.from_bytes(res_pkt[10:12], byteorder="little")
        if req_pkt[0] != res_pkt[0]:

                f"NSM command code mismatch {req_pkt[6]}:{res_pkt[6]}"
            )
        if res_pkt[7] != 0:
            raise MctpNsmCmd.CcReasonError(res_pkt)
        # Skip the size check for get rot state information and debug token commands
        if (req_pkt[5] == 0x06 and req_pkt[6] == 0x01) or (
            req_pkt[5] == 0x04 and req_pkt[6] in (0x01, 0x02, 0x03)
        ):  # Debug Token: Install(0x01), Erase(0x02), Query(0x03)
            return
        else:
            if size != len(res_pkt[12:]):
                raise MctpNsmCmd.InvalidPacket(
                    f"Data size mismatch {size}:{len(res_pkt[12:])}"
                )

    def execute(self, **arg) -> list[int]:
        type, cmd, message = self._req(**arg)
        req_pkt = self._create_req(type, cmd, message)
        self._client.write(req_pkt)
        res_pkt = self._client.read()
        self._verify_res(req_pkt, res_pkt)
        # get rot state information don't have reserved (2 bytes) & data size (2 bytes)

        if format_spec and format_spec.lower().endswith("x"):
            return format(int(self), format_spec)
        return str(self)

        ret = cls._value2member_map_.get(val, None)
        if ret is None:

            class UnknownEnum(IntEnumStr):
                UNKNOWN = val

            return UnknownEnum(val)
        return ret
